newsitem.title: USA: Flores & Rucks buys into Louisiana field.
newsitem.headline: Flores & Rucks buys into Louisiana field.

text.p: Flores & Rucks Inc said Monday it had completed the purchase of certain interests in various state leases in a Louisiana field from a unit of Chevron Corp for $55.7 million.
The company, which explores and produces oil and natural gas, said it had bought interest in the Main Pass Block 69 field, offshore Plaquemines Parish, Louisiana, from Chevron U.S.A. Inc.
Located next to its Main Pass 69 holdings, the acquisition includes interests in 27 producing wells located on 5,898 gross acres, it said.

"Current estimated production from the newly acquired interests is approximately 3,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day net to the company," it said, adding that the purchase brought its ownership to a total of about 22,000 gross acres in the Main Pass Block 69 field.

"This transaction will allow us to immediately commence full-scale development of the Main Pass area, which represents the second substantial component of our Delta core area of operations," it said. "We plan to direct a significant amount of capital toward the Main Pass area in the next two years, with the opportunity to achieve results analogous to those experienced at our East Bay complex."
